qualification.host: madmax Intel Linux, accessed as bullwinkle, nested VMX/KVM
qualification.archive_contents: Original receipt, exact source patch and installation artifact hashes, both phase logs, console logs, packet captures, public SSH key and host-key pin, and functional-session transcripts. Private identity and disk are excluded.
proofs: Pinned live ISO installation to fresh 8 GiB writable virtio disk
Fresh platform boot using the persistent root partition
Console-pinned key-only SSH, interactive terminal, identity, file/process, network/DNS, and package install/execute/remove
qualification.limits: One vCPU and 2 GiB RAM on a shared Intel KVM host. Reboot uses the externally pinned ISO kernel and filtered initramfs, not the installed bootloader. No kernel-update, concurrent bulk-download, bare-metal, or desktop claim. Desktop qualification uses a separate copy of this disk.
qualification.subsequent_finding: The initial SSH acceptance harness lacked a final sync after package operations. A later boot of the copied disk recovered its ext4 journal but retained pacman's lock. The original receipt and disk are preserved; a disposable copy was checked offline and the stale lock removed. Final-sync and repeated cold-boot qualification are recorded separately.
